subject: MPA roadmap & decision ladder — next steps
message_1:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Miller <evan@fivepoint.io>, Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@fivepoint.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: MPA roadmap & decision ladder — next steps

Hi Evan / Priya —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we have a single source of truth for the stakeholders and timing we discussed. I focused the plan around the core goals you called out: reducing inference cost per request, hitting 95th percentile latency under 200ms for your query load, and keeping data residency inside your US region for audit purposes.

Top-level takeaways:
- Pain: current vendor struggles with bursty throughput and opaque token billing.
- Goal: predictable per-request economics and a reliable SLO for latency.
- Constraints: SOC 2 evidence required by procurement, procurement window targeting end of August.

Proposed MAP (high level):
1) Discovery sprint (this week -> Jul 28) — data sample ingestion + latency profile run. Owner: FivePoint (Evan). Deliverable: sample workload + expected QPS.
2) Pilot config & run (Jul 29 -> Aug 12) — Redwood to provision dedicated test pool, initial quantization profile, and cost estimates. Owner: Marissa (Redwood). Deliverable: pilot results + latency/cost dashboard.
3) Security & procurement gating (Aug 2 -> Aug 20) — exchange SOC2/arch diagrams, finalize contract terms. Owner: Priya (FivePoint) + Ben (Redwood). Deliverable: completed SOC2 review and redlines.
4) Exec review & sign (Aug 21 -> Aug 30) — internal FivePoint exec alignment and signature. Owner: Evan + FivePoint legal. Deliverable: signed order + start date.

Decision ladder (as discussed):
- Technical validation (pilot) -> Procurement alignment (SOC2 + pricing) -> Executive signoff.

Next steps (for this week):
- Evan: send the anonymized sample logs and expected QPS by EOD Friday (Jul 23).
- Ben: I’ll loop Ben to prepare a short pilot SOW and cost estimate; he’ll drop a draft into the Drive folder.
- Jasmine: can you confirm which model variants we should test first (higher-accuracy vs. optimized quantized)?

Attached: initial MAP workbook (v1) and our SOC2 summary. I’ll update the workbook once we get the sample data.

Thanks — looking forward to moving quickly.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0179

Attachments: fivepoint-mpa-v1.xlsx (workbook), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (overview)

Evan — thanks for the quick reply and the ask on the attestation. A few updates and clarifications: 

1) Pilot start: Jul 30 is fine — I updated the workbook and attached v2 of the MAP with the shifted dates.
2) SOC2 attestation: Ben confirmed we can provide the formal SOC2 Type II attestation under NDA; I’ve asked our compliance team to prepare a redacted copy for your procurement team. Ben, please drop the attestation or a path to obtain it into the Drive link today.
3) TCO / outage notes: I asked our solutions team (Jasmine) to prepare a short TCO sheet and a short note on our graceful degradation / fallback policy for the pilot — Jasmine, aiming for a draft by EOD Thursday.

Updated milestones (sheet v2):
- Discovery data delivered: Jul 22 (Evan)
- Pilot provisioning & config: Jul 30 -> Aug 13 (Redwood)
- Security review complete: Aug 6 -> Aug 18 (FivePoint procurement + Redwood compliance)
- Commercial redline window: Aug 19 -> Aug 26
- Exec sign target: Aug 30

Owners (concise):
- Evan: dataset + infra contact (Samir)
- Priya: procurement lead (legal packet reviewer)
- Ben: commercial + attestation delivery
- Jasmine: pilot config + TCO brief
- Marissa: program owner / points of contact across teams

What I need today from FivePoint: the anonymized log sample (or a short pointer to a stored S3 object) and the infra contact's Slack handle so our infra team can coordinate the provisioning window.

I attached: fivepoint-mpa-v2.xlsx (updated dates & owners) and a redwood-soc2-summary.pdf placeholder. I also added a HubSpot note linking the MAP to the deal (see related links).

If that matches your expectations I’ll lock the MAP in the Drive and send a short calendar invite for the pilot kickoff (Jul 30).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
